content_sections.heading: About CRS
content_sections.text: The Commission of Railway Safety is a Government of India body under the Ministry of Civil Aviation. This vacancy is in the office of the Commissioner of Railway Safety, Southern Circle, located on the 2nd Floor of Rail Sanraksha Bhavan, behind the Railway Divisional office in Bengaluru. The circular is issued by Nitish Kumar Ranjan, Dy.Commissioner of Railway Safety/Tech, Southern Circle, Bengaluru, and the notice describes the post as an expected vacancy.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Willing officers who meet the conditions must have their application forwarded to the Southern Circle office through proper channel, that is, through their present employer. The complete application, in duplicate and in the prescribed proforma, is to be submitted to this address: Office of Commissioner of Railway Safety, 2nd Floor, Rail Sanraksha Bhawan, Behind Divisional Railway Manager Office, Bangalore -560023 Fill the bio-data cum application proforma (Annexure-A, attached with the circular) in duplicate. Attach the last five years APARs duly attested, the Vigilance Clearance certificate and the Integrity Certificate. Get the application verified and certified by your employer that the particulars you have furnished are correct, and signed under "Verified and forwarded (On behalf of Employer)". Have the employer forward the application through proper channel to the address above. Make sure it reaches the office within 60 days from the date of publication of the circular in the Employment News on 24.10.2026; the notice gives the original last date of receipt as 22.12.2026. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope or a particular postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Classification: General Central Service Group 'B' Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial. Method of recruitment: Deputation (including short term). Who can apply: Officials under the Central Government or State Governments or Union Territories or Universities or recognized research institutes of Public Sector Undertaking or Statutory or Autonomous Organisations. Eligibility criteria: As mentioned in Recruitment Rules (Column 11 of GSR 37 in Annexure 2). The notice itself does not print the educational qualification or experience. Age limit: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short-term contract) shall not be exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application. If the time limit for applications is extended, the maximum age will still be reckoned from the original last date of receipt of applications, which is 22.12.2026. Period of deputation: The period of deputation (including short-term contract), including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or another organisation or department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. The bio-data proforma asks applicants to list the essential and desired qualifications and experience required for the post against those they hold. Candidates should check the discipline-specific eligibility for the post in the official notification and the Recruitment Rules it refers to.

rows.pay: Level-7 in the Pay Matrix of 7th CPC (i.e Pre-revised GP Rs.4600/-)

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Bio-data cum application proforma (Annexure-A), in duplicate Last five years APARs, duly attested Vigilance Clearance certificate Integrity Certificate Employer's verification and certification that the particulars furnished by the applicant are correct The bio-data proforma asks for: Name and address in block letters, date of birth (in Christian era) and date of retirement under Central/State Government Rules Educational qualifications, and whether the essential and desired qualifications/experience for the post are met (with the authority for any equivalence) Details of employment in chronological order: office, post held, from, to, scale of pay and basic pay, nature of duties (a separate signed sheet may be attached) Nature of present employment (ad hoc, temporary, quasi permanent or permanent) and, if on deputation or contract, the date of initial appointment, period and parent organisation Whether working under Central Government, State Government, Autonomous Organisations, Government undertakings or Universities; whether in the revised scale of pay; total emoluments per month now drawn Additional information supporting suitability, whether the applicant belongs to SC/ST, and remarks

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: A candidate will not be allowed to withdraw their name in the event of selection. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained. Applications received other than through proper channel will not be entertained. Applications without ACRs and other certificates as required will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical) recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Sr.Inspector (Technical) (Civil Engineering) in the Office of the Commissioner of Railway Safety, Southern Circle, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical) application?
faq.answer: Applications must be received within 60 days from publication of the circular in the Employment News on 24.10.2026; the notice gives the original last date of receipt as 22 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical)?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria are as mentioned in the Recruitment Rules (Column 11 of GSR 37 in Annexure 2), and the post is in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical) deputation post?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment by deputation (including short-term contract) is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application, reckoned from the original last date of 22.12.2026 even if the date is extended.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical)?
faq.answer: The post carries Level-7 in the Pay Matrix of 7th CPC (i.e Pre-revised GP Rs.4600/-) and is a General Central Service Group 'B' Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial post.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for the CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical) post?
faq.answer: Officials under the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories, Universities, recognized research institutes of Public Sector Undertaking or Statutory or Autonomous Organisations can apply on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical)?
faq.answer: Fill the bio-data cum application proforma in duplicate and have it forwarded through proper channel to the Office of Commissioner of Railway Safety, 2nd Floor, Rail Sanraksha Bhawan, Behind Divisional Railway Manager Office, Bangalore -560023.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be attached to the CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical) application?
faq.answer: The last five years APARs duly attested, the Vigilance Clearance certificate and the Integrity Certificate must be attached, and the employer should verify and certify the particulars furnished.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical) deputation?
faq.answer: The period of deputation (including short-term contract), counting any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q10. Can a selected candidate withdraw from the CRS Sr.Inspector (Technical) selection?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that candidates will not be allowed to withdraw their names in the event of their selection.
